name: The Rise and Fall of Gemini
source:
An early pioneer of space flight tells the story of his friendship with a fellow astronaut - a friendship doomed by their passion for space exploration.

[From [url=https://renai.us/game/gemini]Ren'Ai Archive[/url]]
translation:
一位早期太空飞行先驱讲述自己与另一名宇航员的友谊——两人对太空探索的热情，注定令这段友谊走向悲剧。

[摘自[url=https://renai.us/game/gemini]Ren'Ai Archive[/url]]
